scope: Close the current exact Metal gray8 resident NCC optimization phase, not all future algorithm research.
sequence: Research primary papers and official implementations
Screen bounded u32 accumulation, cached sliding source moments, SIMD32 mapping
If complementary winners exist, test combination; retain unsuccessful variants
Formal main and full-resolution supplement, independent holdouts and separate profiles
Release, differential overflow/boundary, Metal validation, sanitizers and source replay
Archive all sources/results/failed gates; summarize conditional best route and remaining limits

gates.primary_target: at least10% median end-to-end reduction on both128/512 vs peak-tiled/fine0 baseline
gates.time: each block <= baseline+max(2ms,10%); also report hybrid separately

memory: RSS, retained named Metal allocations, and static threadgroup storage separately; never sum RSS and Metal bytes
retention: Keep original and experimental modes and complete source. Default remains unchanged until explicit evidence-based decision.
closure: Finish finite variants, formal best/controls, regression/holdout/profile and validation before final summary. No unbounded search for universal GPU superiority.
limits: gray8 resident matcher; RGB and CUDA are separate scopes
Synthetic independent ground truth; no annotated real sequence available
No claim that current GPU search exhausts algorithmic improvements
No new30-minute soak required for arithmetic-only variant; use repeated calls and full validation and report any stability limit
cross_version_control: Frozen Stage39 binary vs current fine0 and fine4 on original128/512,3 alternating blocks2repeats1secwarmup; detect shared-kernel baseline regressions.

stability_supplement.purpose: Short arithmetic-variant regression and at least one session teardown/recreation; not new30-minute qualification
stability_supplement.exact_outputs: Each loop compares complete outputs to independently GT-validated first result; stream omits poses to keep bounded host memory
